notes: Voiceover scripts for the 14 s designed slide reels. Each line is timed to a slide: S01 hook 0-2 s, S02-S03 product 2-7.5 s, S04 styling 7.5-10 s, S05 price + CTA 10-14 s.
Max ~32 words so a natural female read fits with the music dipped underneath.

Placeholders: {town}, {team} (town + mascot, e.g. 'Connetquot T-Birds'), {product} (e.g. 'heritage script crop hoodie'), {price} ('starting at fifty-four ninety-nine' for a price range, 'just fifty-four ninety-nine' for one price), {cta}.
Rules from the 47 Swag Co playbook: no delivery-date promises, no live-preview language, no fake social proof or scarcity. Don't speak coupon codes (offers change; the S05 slide shows them).
CTA: Facebook comments hold a clickable product link; on Instagram say 'link in bio'. Use cta_facebook / cta_instagram.
cta_instagram: Shop it at the link in bio.

angles.why: Calls out the viewer's identity in the first second (local pride). Meta: put the brand and key message in the first 3 seconds.
lines: Cropped, cozy, and made for game day.

angles.why: Direct-question hook, one of the three hook types clothing-brand Reel guides recommend.
lines: Throw it on with jeans and you're done.

angles.why: Speaks to the buyer (moms shopping for daughters), matching the MOMS offer on the S05 slides.
lines: Moms, she's going to live in this.

angles.why: Announcement hook: the product and 'now available' land in the first 3 seconds.
lines: Style it your way, every day.

angles.why: Problem/solution hook: names an everyday problem, then shows the fix.
